text: A face of the curd is coated with vegetable charcoal before pressing, which leaves the horizontal black line through the uncooked, pressed paste. The rind is built up solely by rubbing the wheels with salt water during at least 45 days of ripening.

steps.note: One face of the curd is coated with vegetable charcoal, which leaves a black line through the pressed paste.
The curd is pressed lightly into cakes of 5–8 kg and 30–40 cm.

steps.name: rub
steps.note: The wheels are rubbed with salt water, which may carry lactic starters; no colourings are used.
